body:
Refreshed with main (c8a1bab1): `upstream/main` merged in with no textual conflict. Head is now a7179f8b. `.claude/PROCESS_VERSION` stays at main's 18, since this slice bumps nothing.

Main's merge brought in a semantic break. Main's recorded-stream guards (b471395e) build `Dump { wcs: "G54" }`, at `crates/post/tests/recorded_streams.rs:44` and `crates/app/tests/recorded_post_streams.rs:75,142`. Since this slice made `Dump::wcs` a u32 index, those literals are now `wcs: 1`.

Stream files: I regenerated them, through the suites' documented path (`WRITE_GOLDEN=1 cargo test -p camcraft-post --test recorded_streams` and `-p camcraft-app --test recorded_post_streams`). Slice 1's legacy-word path still reads `PARAM WorkOffset G54` as 1, so leaving the files alone was considered. It was dropped because the guards compare the dump's output to each file byte for byte, and with the index literal six of the post guards failed as stale. The dump writes the index, so the files must carry it. The only diff is `PARAM WorkOffset G54` -> `PARAM WorkOffset 1.000000`: 9 lines in 8 generated streams. The hand-written `full_circle_raw.cnc` stays as it is. It round-trips unchanged and keeps covering the legacy-word read.

Posted goldens: every file under `crates/post/tests/recorded/golden/<post>/` is byte-identical (`git status` shows no change there). Each script suite posts the regenerated streams against them and passes 9/9: carvera, doosan_dnm, fanuc, fanuc_lathe, haas, heidenhain, mazak, sinumerik, tormach, tormach_lathe. `script_tormach_plasma` fails 8, the known #1146 on main: its refusal text is stale ("no machine is stated"), unrelated to the work offset.

Tests: all of `camcraft-post --tests` except that suite is green (recorded_streams 10, work_offset_index 9, post_engine 33, ...). App `recorded_post_streams` 2/2, `wcs_index` 4/4, `fanuc_post` 11/11, `inverted_probe` 9/9, `probe_dialects` 13/13, `sinumerik_work_offsets` 2/2. Clippy `-D warnings` is clean on post `--all-targets` and on app `--lib --test recorded_post_streams`; it ran per target because of #1146. Stays draft.

Refreshed with main (6a10c5ad), merged in through the refreshed parent #1101 (558e61e5). No textual conflicts: both sides regenerated the recorded streams to the same `PARAM WorkOffset 1.000000`. After that, merging main directly was already up to date. Main added no new Dump literals or streams that needed the index rule, and no golden moved. PROCESS_VERSION is 25, the same as main; this PR doesn't change it. Head a9f8e289.

Tests: every camcraft-post suite passes: `work_offset_index` 9, `recorded_streams` 10, all eleven `script_*` suites 9 each, `post_engine` 33. App `wcs_index` 4/4, `mcp` 18/18, `recorded_post_streams` 2/2, `sinumerik_work_offsets` 2/2. Clippy on post, app and ui with `-D warnings` is clean. Mergeable. (There is no `mcp_work_offset` suite on this branch, so I ran nothing under that name.)
Quick pass (M5): body complete, gate reported green on this head, no open requested change; flagged ready for review. Conflicts with main (if any) are refreshed at merge time (PROCESS_VERSION 31).
Back to draft (M5): my quick pass readied this by mistake. It's held for the user's PathPilot Hub run, and there's no hands-on result yet. It goes ready again once that run is recorded.
